newsitem.title: USA: D&P raises Black & Decker debt rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P raises Black & Decker debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it raised Black & Decker Corp's senior unsecured debt rating to triple-B from triple-B-minus. The rating action affects about $1.1 billion of debt.
Duff said the upgrade balances a moderate degree of leverage and competitive market conditions against leading business positions in most operating units and steadily improved financial results.
"Credit protection measures are expected to improve further as free cash flow, anticipated by management to average $100 million per annum, will be used to reduce debt," Duff said.

Although Black & Decker has increased inventory levels in anticipation of third quarter 1997 new product introductions and to address distribution service, improved working capital management has strengthened cash flow.
